data.name: Crystal Reign
data.detailed_description:
Nova atualização

Store Page Update:

Guide:
Build Towers to defend your Crystal. Towers will gain experience when they defeat enemies or when you are in the tower.

Arrow Towers
-Long Range, Medium Damage
-Upgrading increases Range

Cannon Towers
-Low Range, Medium Damage with Splash
-Upgrading increases Damage
-Have difficulties hitting rabbits

Ice Towers
-Medium Range, Low Damage
-Upgrading increases Slow Duration

Support Towers
-Percent based Damage Buff to nearby Towers
-Upgrading increases Damage Buff %

Upgrade Color Indicators
-Lvl 0: Blue
-Lvl 1: Green
-Lvl 2: Yellow
-Lvl 3: Magenta
-Lvl 4: Red
-Lvl 5: Black
How to Upgrade:
-Sit in a Tower
-Get a last hit while firing from a tower

Being Active in Crystal Reign:
-You can punch and melee enemies! Just don't let them touch you, as you will lose gold from this!
-You can teleport into towers to take control of them. This will also passively upgrade towers.

Ultimate Crystal
-Pick this up to one shot mobs or do a lot of damage to boss enemies.
-Use this as a last resort!


Acerca do jogo

Experience a siege game like never before. Dive into the Fantasy universe in VR where you are the hero...or villain.

Key Features
Strategically place weapon towers along the enemy path to destroy your enemies before they reach your base!
Enter your towers to enhance, aim, and fire at enemies yourself!
Unleash your ultimate attack of magic upon your enemies as the skies darken and your power overwhelms!
Explore the map for hidden treasure to collect gold and ultimate crystals with VR dash-teleport!
Discover enemy strengths and weaknesses to different towers!
Get attacked by enemies who steal your gold and steal your gold back!
Conquer the bosses of the woodlands and claim it as your own!
Navigate through the first-time tutorial and learn to play the game!
Beat your high score in the never-ending forever-changing Infinite Mode!

Towers
- Arrow Towers
- Cannon Towers
- Ice Towers
- Support Towers
- Anti-Air Towers

Enemies
- Dwarves
- Rabbit Warriors
- Golems
- Ravens
- Ogres

Landscape
- Caves
- Mountains
- Dirt Paths
- Rivers
- Lake

Available for Arcades on SpringboardVR

reviews.review:
Game is interesting take on tower defense. It is different from conventional tower defense games such as element TD; there is a minimal ammount of information with regards to enemies, towers, and weakness and advantages of each e.g. it wasn't clear that the golems were weak to cannons, nor is there an indicator of how much damage each tower does. It keeps things interesting with VR interactions, such as first-person interactions, tower turret control, and melee. The waves seemed easy to me, and it wasn't clear what kinds of enemies were coming (hint: it's in the pause menu). There was an infinite mode that can be unlocked after defeating the 13 waves or so (also hidden in the pause menu), which was more challenging

TL;DR Basically a simplified tower-defense-styled game with Pokemon-like health UI, beautifully crafted environment, and novel aspects like melee and tower control not seen in conventional TD. I think it's worth a try if you are looking for tower defense but want to try a new VR interaction method
